//: CDF: PLUT1. The contents of a plutonium fuel pack: one item per 500 charges, so a pack weighs and measures from the data. One plut_cell is 500 charges (PLUTONIUM_CHARGES) and stays the item the player loads and gets back; plut_cell has 80 g and 250 ml per 5 count, so one cell is 80 g and 50 ml and each charge is 160 mg.
description: The plutonium of a fuel cell, held loose inside a fuel pack.  It cannot be used on its own.

//: CDF: PLUT1. Body numbers copied from light_atomic_battery_cell (capacity 1000 matches).
description: A shielded pack that holds up to two plutonium fuel cells worth of fuel.  Load a plutonium fuel cell into it to refill it; unloading it gives back whole cells.

//: CDF: PLUT1. Body numbers copied from medium_atomic_battery_cell (capacity 5000 matches).

//: CDF: PLUT2. Body numbers: half of medium_atomic_battery_cell (750 g, 500 ml), so 375 g and 250 ml; capacity 2500 is 5 cells.
